items.title: The canonical decomposition of a module-valued functor on square-zero extensions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a module-valued functor F on Alg_A, every B-algebra and B-module N, the lemma produces a canonical decomposition F(B[N]) = F(B) + TF(B, N) together with five structural properties: the description of TF as a kernel, its B-module structure, its functoriality in the pair, the canonical maps N tensor_B F(B) -> TF(B, N), and the behaviour on zero (statement lines 1137-1158). The proof builds the decomposition from the splitting of B -> B[N] -> B, obtains functoriality from an explicitly displayed commutative cube of algebras, derives the module structure from the B[N]-module structure, exhibits the map of item (4) as an explicit composite whose image lands in TF, and finishes with a remaining item (proof lines 1161-1185). The level is H3: the object is constructed and each of its listed properties is checked, with the diagrams and the composite map written out.
